description: Header file for the lib transfer module of libcurl, defining function prototypes, enums, macros, and external references related to data transfer operations.

methods.name: Curl_checkheaders
methods.description: Checks headers against a set of known headers, to determine if a specific header is present.

methods.name: Curl_pretransfer
methods.description: Prepares the easy handle for transfer.

methods.name: Curl_posttransfer
methods.description: Performs cleanup or final steps after transfer.

methods.name: Curl_follow
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirection based on the follow type.

methods.name: Curl_readwrite
methods.description: Performs the core read/write operations for data transfer.

methods.name: Curl_single_getsock
methods.description: Selects the socket(s) associated with the transfer for polling.

methods.name: Curl_retry_request
methods.description: Handles retrying a request if needed.

methods.name: Curl_meets_timecondition
methods.description: Checks if the request meets certain time conditions.

methods.name: Curl_xfer_write_resp
methods.description: Writes response bytes received from the server.

methods.name: Curl_xfer_write_resp_hd
methods.description: Writes a header line from server response.

methods.name: Curl_xfer_setup
methods.description: Sets up the transfer parameters for a new transfer.

methods.name: Curl_xfer_write_done
methods.description: Finalizes the transfer, handling any last responses.

methods.name: Curl_xfer_send_close
methods.description: Closes the sending side of the transfer.

ctags.name: FOLLOW_FAKE
ctags.pattern: /^  FOLLOW_FAKE,  \/* only records stuff, not actually following *\/$/

ctags.name: FOLLOW_NONE
ctags.pattern: /^  FOLLOW_NONE,  \/* not used within the function, just a placeholder to$/

ctags.name: FOLLOW_RETRY
ctags.pattern: /^  FOLLOW_RETRY, \/* set if this is a request retry as opposed to a real$/
